spec.source_user_request: Prepare the twelve-space workbook and ask for Space 307 missing supply and return flows.

criteria.requirement: The requested Revit outcome is completed and verified with evidence from this assignment.

clarify-space-307-airflows.question: What Supply CFM and Return CFM should I use for L3 Space 307?

facts.value: Export selected elements to an Excel spreadsheet under Workspace without changing Revit. Native typed values, units, display and field status in Elements, Issues and Readme. Use observed elementIds and exact parameterNames (max 2000 elements, 100 fields); inspect a representative element first. Optional supplementalTables preserve supplied inputs, proposed device quantities and review results, visibly assistant-authored with native identity columns. Each table requires every selected elementId exactly once; missing, duplicate or foreign rows reject before writing. Up to 4 tables, 32 columns each, 64000 total cells; scalar JSON values only (null is missing, zero remains zero, strings are not formulas). Body: {elementIds:[...],parameterNames:[...],outputFolder?,fileName?,dryRun?,supplementalTables:[{name,contentKind:'user_input_transcription'|'assistant_proposal'|'review',columns:[...],rows:[{elementId,values:[...]}]}]}. Supply all requested spaces and deliverables; native selection coverage is not proof of complete task scope or engineering correctness. Existing files are never overwritten. Verify artifact_receipt with inspect-exported-files.
export selected elements and proposed quantities to xlsx

criterion-f96c0e52719d530e4da1.reason: All required semantic facts are authoritatively supported.

assessment.overview: Twelve-space workbook; Space 307 supply and return remain missing.

findings.title: Workbook delivered
findings.text: The workbook contains 12 selected spaces and three supplemental worksheets: Source-Checked Inputs, Proposed Device Quantities, and Missing Input and Review. Independent inspection found the exact file readable and nonzero, with a matching SHA-256 digest.

findings.title: Proposed quantities
findings.text: For the 11 spaces with complete flows, the proposal totals 24 supply devices, 13 return devices, and 2 exhaust devices, using quantity = ceiling(flow ÷ exercise limit). Explicit zeroes remain zero, and Spaces 301A and 302 remain exhaust-only.

findings.title: Missing input preserved
findings.text: L3 Space 307 remains explicitly incomplete: Supply CFM and Return CFM are missing, so both proposed quantities are TBD; Exhaust CFM remains the supplied explicit zero.

findings.title: Scope limitation
findings.text: The workbook labels the limits as software-acceptance inputs only and does not select physical sizes, invent loads, alter the Revit model, or claim an engineered HVAC design.

limitations: Space 307 supply and return quantities cannot be finalized until its two missing flows are supplied.
The device limits are exercise rules only, not engineering criteria.
questions: What Supply CFM and Return CFM should I use for L3 Space 307?
